text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the February Stakes. In the 
pouring rain, the challenger Biko Pegasus 
was welcomed by roaring cheers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Shinko Windy was expected to 
bring surprises outside of just her 
racing. Biko Pegasus hoped for a heated 
showdown to shatter that image.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, at another racecourse, Narita 
Brian was drawing massive attention upon 
making her return from injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus felt a burning sense of 
rivalry toward Narita Brian over the 
spotlight she commanded.
